meta.title: Job offers for electricians — employers come to you
meta.description: Build an anonymous profile and let employers bid with a concrete salary. €0 for tradespeople — you decide which offers to accept.

hero.title: Stop chasing dozens of vacancies.
hero.subtitle: Create one profile, set your terms, and receive structured offers from employers with the salary stated up front. Anonymous until you say yes.

step1.title: Build your profile
step1.text: Trade, skills, certifications and availability. No name, no contact details — employers see your trade content only.

step2.title: Employers make offers
step2.text: Every offer is structured: salary, hours, benefits and contract type are stated up front.

step3.title: You decide
step3.text: Compare offers at your own pace and accept what fits. Acceptance is always your choice.

privacy.title: You control what's visible
privacy.line1: Anonymous by default: employers don't see your identity — only your trade, skills and region.
privacy.line2: Block employers: exclude your current employer (or any other) by name from your search results.
privacy.line3: Invisible at any time: switch your profile to hidden — just as easily as turning it on.
privacy.line4: Salary up front: every offer states salary and terms, so you compare with the full picture.

free.title: OfferMarket is free for tradespeople
free.text: Always. No sign-up fee, no subscription, no cost per offer. Employers fund the marketplace.

honesty.title: What we don't promise here
honesty.text: We don't guarantee a number of offers. A new platform with real, verified employers doesn't mean an offer arrives daily — it means every offer that does arrive comes with a concrete salary and is aimed at you.

cta.note: Are you an employer? See how to find tradespeople → go to the employer page.

meta.title: Find a sought-after electrician — structured offers, €499 only on acceptance
meta.description: Search verified electrician profiles with certifications and availability. Structured offers, €499 only on acceptance — no placement fees.

hero.title: Search skilled electricians.
hero.subtitle: Filter by trade, certifications (NEN 3140/VCA), availability and experience. Make structured offers with salary stated up front — and pay only if the candidate accepts.

step1.title: Register and verify your company
step1.text: Company name and KvK number at sign-up; we verify your registration before your first offer (target: within 4 working hours on weekdays).

step2.title: Search profiles that match your need
step2.text: Filter by trade, certification, specialisation, languages, availability and experience — including tradespeople who aren't actively job-hunting.

step3.title: Make a structured offer
step3.text: Salary, hours, benefits and contract type — the candidate sees the full picture, and your offer only takes effect on acceptance.

model.title: One amount, only on acceptance
model.line1: €499 per accepted introduction — no subscription, no recruitment budget, no cost if nobody accepts.
model.line2: Search and make as many offers as you want; you're invoiced only after a candidate says yes.
model.line3: Compare that with the classic agency model: recruitment & selection firms charge 20–25% of annual salary, job boards €250–425 per posting.

privacy.title: Why tradespeople are visible here that you'll find nowhere else
privacy.text: Anonymous profiles remove the barrier. Skilled tradespeople who prefer not to publish their name — but are open to a better job or better terms — are searchable here, on trade content and certification.

honesty.title: What we don't promise here
honesty.text: We don't guarantee placements. An offer is a proposal; the candidate decides. What you do know: every profile you see is actively available in our search environment.

cta.note: Are you a tradesperson? OfferMarket is free — employers pay.
